text:
mira: seeing a cluster-wide blip in us-west2-GPU yesterday? nodes in rack-3 are rebooting repeatedly :grimacing:
infra-bot: [ALERT] 6 GPU nodes reported unexpected reset in us-west2-rack3 within 8m. Impact: Dedicated pools reduced capacity by ~25%.
jon: yep I see pod evictions and backpressure on the batch queue. Latency spike on model-serving-rt.
rashid: logs show repeated PCI link retrain and kernel nvme recoveries on the affected hosts. not pure ECC this time.
mira: any manual actions we want immediate? cordon/drain or let autoscaler handle it?
oncall_sre: cordon the unstable nodes to avoid noisy restarts hurting schedulers. i'll start draining low-priority pods.
anya: ETA on full drain? we should move steady traffic to eu-west as fallback for critical routes.
jon: draining now for host gpu-uw2-3b-11: 1/6 low-prio pods left.
jon: running:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-uw2-3b-11
kubectl drain gpu-uw2-3b-11 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
oliver: i'll bump routing weight off us-west2 for production-redwood-dedicated to reduce SLO risk. shifting 30% to eu-west via traffic-controller.
rashid: confirm hardware controller logs show repeated PCIe PHY retrain after power sequencer cycle. possibly rack PDU glitch.
anya: opening incident ticket with hw-vendor + datacenter ops. linking logs and time windows.
infra-bot: Created ticket INF-2026-4386 -> vendor: rack-PDU-surge-investigation.
mira: can we temporarily reduce batch size on samplers to lower token pressure? that's cheap change.
jon: reducing batch_size from 32 -> 16 on qps-critical models, deploying config now.
jon: prod traffic metrics: request latency coming down after shift and batch change. queue length stabilizing.
oncall_sre: still seeing 2 nodes flapping. i've quarantined them and marked as unschedulable. recommending replacement hardware.
rashid: agree, flapping after soft power cycle means PDU or riser. not just firmware. log snippet:
```
[kernel] pcie link train failed: retry
[hwmon] power sequencing abnormal: voltage dip detected
```
anya: ordering replacement riser kits and scheduling rack-level maintenance window in 6h. vendor said expedited shipping available.
oliver: cost note: shifted traffic to eu-west increased egress and spot VM cost ~12% for the hour. filing cost blip to infra-costs.
mira: postmortem action items: 1) add automated PDU flapping detection 2) add faster routing fallback policy for dedicated pools 3) vendor follow-up + hardware replacement 4) update runbook for PCIe flaps
oncall_sre: I'll create the incident channel #incident-gpu-usw2 and invite oncall + hw.
anya: INF-2026-4386 updated with parts order and maintenance window.
jon: final check: all critical routes stable, capacity ~95% of baseline after shift. marking thread for follow-up.
mira: thanks everyone. let's reconvene in the incident channel for the postmortem tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
